summary: xAI announced that eToro's AI agent Tori is now powered by SpaceXAI's models to provide real-time market sentiment analysis drawn from X.

categories.reason: eToro's investing agent Tori is being upgraded with SpaceXAI models to embed real-time market sentiment into its core investing workflow, a direct product change for a consumer finance platform.
categories.quote: Tori, eToro’s AI agent, uses models from SpaceXAI to embed real-time market sentiment directly into Tori’s investing workflow.
